company_name: Shanghai Simpure Gas Technology Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in gas purification equipment specifically for the semiconductor industry.
summary: Shanghai Simpure Gas Technology Co., Ltd. is a leading supplier of gas purification equipment tailored for the semiconductor sector. With over 21 years of experience and a strong focus on innovation, the company offers a range of products and services aimed at enhancing gas technology and electronic technology applications.
capabilities: Gas purification equipment for semiconductor manufacturing
Technology development and consulting in gas technology
Production and maintenance of specialized gas purification systems
